text: ポケモンが　とても　きもち　よさそうに　ねてます

structure.jp: とても　きもち　よさそうに

patterns.name: 〜そうだ (looks)
patterns.span: きもち　よさそうに
patterns.explanation: そう on an adjective means 'looks'; いい takes the special shape よさそう, and に tells how the action is done. きもち　よさそうに = 'looking comfortable'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ねてます is the short spoken form of ねています, which says the action is going on now. ねてます = 'is sleeping'.
